scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hm? You're... What is it about you? I've been an honorable Knight for a long time, but I cannot understand this feeling I'm getting from you...
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
嗯？你是...
你身上究竟有什么特别之处？
我当了这么多年光荣的骑士，却说不清从你身上感受到的这种气息...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, a member of our Chivalry.
I hope you are living up to my expectations. We have vowed to be strong for our kingdom, even if death is upon us...
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
啊，是我们骑士团的成员。
希望你没有辜负我的期望。
我们曾立誓，为王国坚强奋战，纵然死亡降临，也绝不退缩...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome,
this is the
Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
欢迎，这里是普隆德拉骑士团。
你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome. We, the proud Knights of the Prontera Chivalry, will give our lives for king and country! Please enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
欢迎。
我们是引以为荣的普隆德拉骑士团，愿为国王与国家献出生命！
请随意参观。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
欢迎，这里是普隆德拉骑士团。
你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
嗯？
{0}，有什么需要帮忙的吗？
啊，你不知道该找谁？

scripts.text: [Captain Herman]
scripts.translation: [团长 赫尔曼]

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
去完成最后一项考验吧。
完成后，负责考验你的骑士们会齐聚一堂，评议你的表现。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
哦...！
技能点还没用完，就不能转职。
把技能点全部分配好，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
哦，所有考验都完成了？
不过，并不是完成考验就一定能成为骑士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
May god bless your body and soul, warrior. I hope you will show your courage and protect those who are weaker than you.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
战士，愿上帝保佑你的身心。
希望你展现勇气，保护比你弱小的人。

scripts.text: I want to change my job to Swordman.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为剑士

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为骑士

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是来看看

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
A-ha~
A Swordman, you say?
I'm sorry, {0}, but you've
come to the wrong place!
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
啊哈~
你说，想当剑士？
抱歉，{0}，你来错地方了！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
This isn't the Swordsman guild, it's the Prontera Chivalry! If you wish to become a Swordman, visit the Swordman Guild located in Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
这里是普隆德拉骑士团，不是剑士公会！
想当剑士，请去依斯鲁得岛的剑士公会。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, I see that you have great ambition. But you must first become a Swordman before becoming
a Knight. One step at a time...
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
啊，看来你很有志向。
不过，想当骑士，得先成为剑士。
一步一步来...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, visit the Swordman guild in Izlude. Then, come visit us again once you have become a well experienced Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
先去依斯鲁得岛的剑士公会吧。
等成为经验丰富的剑士，再来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Aha~
You must have lots of free time. Why don't you go hunt some monsters instead of wandering about aimlessly?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
啊哈~
看来你挺闲的。
与其漫无目的地闲逛，不如去讨伐些魔物？

scripts.text:
Welcome, this is
the Prontera Chivalry.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
欢迎，这里是普隆德拉骑士团。
请问有什么事吗？

scripts.text: I want to change my job to a Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想转职为骑士

scripts.text: Just visiting.
scripts.translation: 只是来看看

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ohh...
A young {0} who wishes
to become a Knight!
Our Prontera Chivalry
will assist you.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
哦...
想当骑士的年轻{0}！
我们普隆德拉骑士团会帮助你。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First of all, I am the captain of the Prontera Chivalry, Herman Phon Efesirsus. I'm pleased to meet young people eager to join the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
先自我介绍一下，我是普隆德拉骑士团团长，赫尔曼·冯·艾菲西斯。
很高兴见到有志加入骑士团的年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
We only accept Swordmen
who are at least Job Level 40.
We cannot consider applicants that are not yet experienced enough to become Knights.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
我们只接受职业等级达到40级的剑士。
经验不足，还不具备成为骑士的资格，就无法受理申请。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once you apply, and we find
you eligible, we will begin the job change procedure. Would you
like to apply now?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
提交申请后，只要确认你符合条件，就会开始转职流程。
现在要申请吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I would like to apply.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要申请

scripts.text: I'd like to think about it please.
scripts.translation: 让我再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, you are not yet ready to become a Knight! Didn't I specifically mention the Job Level 40 requirement?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
啊，你还不具备当骑士的资格！
我不是特意说过，职业等级要达到40级吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return when you have used
all of your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
啊...！
技能点还没用完，就不能转职。
把技能点全部用完再回来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me see...
Your name is
{0}...
Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
让我看看...
你的名字是{0}...对吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Of course I understand your strong desire to join us, but now is not the time. Go out and fight some more monsters. We will be here waiting.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
我理解你急切地想加入我们，但现在还不是时候。
去多讨伐些魔物吧，我们会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Let me explain the job change procedure. You must visit a series of Knights and pass each
of their tests.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
我来说明一下转职流程。
你需要逐一拜访几位骑士，通过他们各自的考验。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Once all the tests are completed, every Knight involved in your testing will gather and discuss your performance.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
完成全部考验后，负责考验你的骑士们会齐聚一堂，评议你的表现。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
The Knights must unanimously approve of you before you can join the Prontera Chivalry. If only one person objects, you must
start over.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
必须得到所有骑士的一致认可，才能加入普隆德拉骑士团。
哪怕只有一人反对，也得从头再来。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
But I believe if you persist with an earnest heart, you shall be acknowledged by the Knights and ultimately recognized as a member of our Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
不过，我相信，只要你怀着诚心坚持到底，必能获得骑士们的认可，成为我们骑士团的一员。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
So, let's not waste any more time talking! Go and meet these Knights and begin their tests. Once you have completed all of the tests, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
好了，不再多说，去拜访那些骑士，开始考验吧！
全部完成后，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Oh...!
Well, I don't want to pressure you. Take your time and think it over. Return when you are ready to
change jobs, for we will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
哦...！
我不想给你压力，慢慢考虑吧。
准备好转职后再来，我们会等着你。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Come to think of it, aren't you a Swordman? It looks like you've encountered many foes in battle.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
说起来，你是剑士吧？
看样子已经身经百战了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
You should consider changing jobs to a Knight. Come and talk to me if you are interested.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
不妨考虑转职骑士。
有兴趣的话，就来找我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Please take
your time in
looking around.
Good day.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
请随意参观。
祝你愉快。

scripts.text:
Mmm?
{0},
what can I do for you?
Ah, you don't know
who to visit?
scripts.translation:
嗯？
{0}，有什么需要帮忙的吗？
啊，你不知道该找谁？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I believe the Knights in charge of testing have set an order in which you must visit them. I suppose it helps the testing process.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
负责考验的骑士们安排了拜访顺序，你得依次去找他们。
这样考验也更容易进行吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
First, go and visit
Sir Andrew for your first test. Don't be too nervous, he'll explain everything once you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
先去找安德鲁爵士，接受第一项考验。
别紧张，找他谈谈，他会详细说明。

scripts.text: It appears that you have finished one test. Let's see. Sir Andrew, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation:
看来你已经完成了一项考验。
让我看看。
安德鲁爵士，这位剑士接下来该找谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
I said to
visit Sir Siracuse.
Funny, I thought I told
you. Did I forget...?
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
我说的是去找西拉库斯爵士。
奇怪，我记得说过啊。
难道忘了...？

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Did you hear?
Go to Sir Siracuse and take his test. Once you complete his test, do not forget who you're supposed to visit next as well.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
听到了吧？
去找西拉库斯爵士，接受他的考验。
完成后，记得问清楚接下来该找谁。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
You've completed two tests.
Sir Siracuse, who must this Swordman visit next?
scripts.translation:
让我看看...
你已经完成两项考验了。
西拉库斯爵士，这位剑士接下来该找谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Oh...!
Um, who was next...?
Right! Sir Windsor!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
噢...！
嗯，下一个是谁来着...？
对了！温莎爵士！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Head over to
Sir Windsor Benedict for your next test. Listen carefully to the Knights in charge of testing so that you don't feel lost, alright?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
下一项考验，去找温莎·本尼迪克特爵士。
仔细听考官们的指示，就不会摸不着头绪了，好吗？

scripts.text:
Sir Windor...?
Who must this
Swordman visit
next?
scripts.translation:
温莎爵士...？
这位剑士接下来该找谁？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
...Amy Beatrice.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...艾米·贝阿特丽丝。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Ah, go and visit
Lady Amy and take her test. Make sure you pay attention to who you must go to for your next test.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
啊，去找艾米女士，接受她的考验。
要记清楚，下一项考验该去找谁。

scripts.text:
Let's see...
Lady Amy, who
must this Swordman
visit next?
scripts.translation:
让我看看...
艾米女士，这位剑士接下来该找谁？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh...
I said to visit
Sir Edmond!
Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哦...
我说的是去找埃德蒙爵士！
Tee hee~

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Now, go and speak
to Sir Edmond. He will
be in charge of your
next test.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
现在去找埃德蒙爵士吧。
由他负责下一项考验。

scripts.text:
Don't you only have to visit one more person? The Knight in
charge of the final test
is Sir Gray Prospheiro.
scripts.translation:
你应该只剩一位考官没拜访了吧？
最后一项考验，由格雷·普罗斯佩罗爵士负责。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
This world operates according
to the law of cause and effect.
All will be revealed in the end.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
这个世界遵循因果法则。
一切终将水落石出。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Be alert and do
your best, as this
is the last test.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
这是最后一项考验，打起精神，全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Return to me
after you have
completed the
final test.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
完成最后一项考验，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
Finish the last test.
Once that is complete, all the Knights involved in your testing shall gather, and we will evaluate your performance.
scripts.translation:
去完成最后一项考验吧。
完成后，负责考验你的骑士们会齐聚一堂，评议你的表现。

scripts.text:
Oh...!
You cannot change jobs if you have unused skill points remaining. Return once you have distributed all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
哦...！
技能点还没用完，就不能转职。
把技能点全部分配好，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
Oh, have you completed all the tests? But not everyone who completes the tests can
become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
哦，所有考验都完成了？
不过，并不是完成考验就一定能成为骑士。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
During the test we see how loyal, honorable and strong you are. We also see if you were courteous and if you know the value of modesty and reverence.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
考验中，我们观察你的忠诚、荣誉与实力，也看你是否有礼，是否懂得谦逊与敬重。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Through this process, I have also observed your actions. All seven of our opinions will be reflected in the decision of your job change.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
这段时间，我也一直留意着你的言行。
我们七个人的意见，将共同决定你能否转职。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Then...
We shall listen
to everyone's thoughts!
Andrew, what do you think?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
那么...
听听各位的意见吧！
安德鲁，你怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
What can I say?
I approve!
Having lived as
a Swordsman up
until now
is enough.
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
还有什么好说的？
我赞成！
能以剑士的身份一路走到现在，已经足够了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Andrew]
This one has
gathered items
that are troublesome
to obtain. I approve!
I believe {0}he will continue to be loyal after becoming a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[安德鲁爵士]
这位收集齐了那些难以取得的物品。
我赞成！
我相信{0}，成为骑士后也会继续保持忠诚。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Hmm.
What a nice review.
Siracuse, what are your thoughts?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
嗯，评价不错。
西拉库斯，你怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Heh, very well. Not quite what
I would want, but hopefully will become better in the future.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
呵，还不错。
虽然离我的期望还有些差距，但愿今后能做得更好。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
After becoming a Knight, you must build a good reputation through honor. Ehh... I approve.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
成为骑士后，要以光荣的行为赢得好名声。
嗯...我赞成。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Okay...
Windsor,
what about you?
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
好...
温莎，你呢？

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
....Approved.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...赞成。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I don't think
he disapproves.
Then, let's listen
to Amy's opinion.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
看来他没有异议。
那么，听听艾米的意见。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ He's so polite!
He'll grow to be a wonderful Knight. And he's got such cute widdle cheeeeks~ Hee hee!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~他真有礼貌！
一定会成为出色的骑士。
而且，那小脸蛋也太可爱了~
Hee hee!

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~ She should be great!
She's very courteous and also very cute, so a few more points! Heh~
I shouldn't be saying things like this!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~她一定会很出色！
既有礼貌，又可爱，再加几分！
Heh~
哎呀，我不该说这种话！

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Well...
A strange review,
but I believe
she approves.
Edmond, speak
your mind.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
嗯...
评价有些奇怪，不过，看来她是赞成的。
埃德蒙，说说你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
He seems a little rough, but something bright shines within him. With polish and refinement, his true value will shine forth
as the sun.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
他还有些粗糙，但内心已有光芒。
经过磨炼与雕琢，他真正的价值必将如太阳般闪耀。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It's difficult to see, but there is a spiritual beauty within her. With polish and refinement, her true value will glow as resplendently
as the moon.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
虽然不易察觉，但她的心灵有着美好的光辉。
经过磨炼与雕琢，她真正的价值必将如月亮般灿烂。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Lastly...
Gray. I would like
to hear your thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
最后...
格雷，我想听听你的意见。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
A young {0} coming here with the determination to become a Knight is enough...
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
一位年轻的{0}，怀着成为骑士的决心来到这里，这就足够了...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
Everyone
has approved.
No one has opposed.
Then I shall tell
you my opinion.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
各位都赞成，没有人反对。
那么，说说我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
My decision is...
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
我的决定是...

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
I approve.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
我赞成。

scripts.text:
[Captain Herman]
You may not have finished all the tests perfectly, but you have all the necessary qualities to become
a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[团长 赫尔曼]
虽然并非每项考验都完成得完美，但你已具备成为骑士所需的全部素质。

多了解一些骑士的知识，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Some Spears also have magical attributes, just like spells. Of the following, which can attack a Nightmare, which has the Ghost attribute?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
有些长矛也像法术一样，带有魔法属性。
以下哪把长矛能攻击念属性的梦魇？

scripts.text: Zephyrus
scripts.translation: 西风长矛

scripts.text: Lance
scripts.translation: 长枪

scripts.text: Bill Guisarme
scripts.translation: 修尔特长矛

scripts.text: Crescent Scythe
scripts.translation: 死神之镰

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong! You'll be doing absolutely no damage with that type of Spear! Come back after you've learned more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错！
那种长矛根本造成不了伤害！
多了解一些骑士的知识，再回来！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
If you have a question, just ask any Knight in town. This is basic knowledge for us!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
有问题就去城里找骑士请教。
这些都是我们的基本知识！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
When you become a Knight you can ride a Peco Peco. However, your attack speed decreases once you're mounted on a Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
当了骑士，就能骑乘大嘴鸟。
不过，骑上大嘴鸟后，攻击速度会下降。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
But, you can counter this speed decrease as you learn the Cavalier Mastery skill. What percentage of your normal attack speed will you have after learning Level 3 Cavalier Mastery?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
学习骑兵修炼，能抵消骑乘时的攻击速度下降。
学到3级后，攻击速度是正常速度的百分之多少？

scripts.text: 70 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的70%

scripts.text: 80 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的80%

scripts.text: 90 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的90%

scripts.text: 100 % of normal attack speed
scripts.translation: 正常攻击速度的100%

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Wrong!
Don't bother riding a Peco Peco if you don't know about Cavalier Mastery!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
错！
连骑兵修炼都不了解，还骑什么大嘴鸟！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You better come back after you've learned a little more about Knights!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
先去多了解一下骑士，再回来吧！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Good, good...
I'm pretty sure you know a decent amount about Knights. Now, let me ask you some personal questions about Knights.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
很好，很好...
看来你对骑士已经相当了解了。
接下来，问几个关于骑士的问题，听听你个人的想法。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
What should you do when you run into a Novice asking for help in town?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
在城里遇到求助的初心者，你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Tell the Novice of a reasonable hunting area.
scripts.translation: 告诉初心者合适的狩猎地点

scripts.text: Let the Novice fight while you take the damage.
scripts.translation: 让初心者战斗，自己承受伤害

scripts.text: Give the Novice a bunch of Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 给初心者大量Zeny和物品

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Of course, even a Novice needs to learn how to be independent. Giving good guidance to Novices is one of the best things we can do.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
没错，初心者也得学会独立。
给他们正确的指引，是我们能做的最好的帮助之一。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You have the wrong idea. Do you really believe that is helping the Novice? Give a man a fish, he will eat for a day. Teach him to fish, he will eat for a lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
想错了。
你真觉得这样是在帮初心者吗？
授人以鱼，不如授人以渔！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Do you really believe that this will truly help the poor Novice? It's generous but, they will not know the true value of zeny and items until they earn it themselves.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
你真觉得这样能帮到那个可怜的初心者？
虽然慷慨，可只有靠自己挣来的Zeny和物品，才能让他们明白其中的价值。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Alright...
Now, how should
you act within
a party?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
好...
那么，在队伍里，你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Protect everyone in the front of the battle.
scripts.translation: 站在战斗前线保护大家

scripts.text: Gather monsters and destroy them at once.
scripts.translation: 把魔物聚在一起，一举消灭

scripts.text: Get as many items possible, at all cost.
scripts.translation: 不惜代价，尽可能多拿物品

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
That's it! Our strength and attacks are very important in a party. All Knights should engage in a battle with that mindset.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
没错！
在队伍里，我们的力量和攻击很重要。
每位骑士都应抱着这种心态战斗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Are you crazy? Don't you realize the flaw in that kind of thinking? You can't control large mobs. What if they kill you? Who will protect the innocent?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
疯了吗？
没想过这样做有什么问题？
魔物太多，你根本控制不住。
万一你死了，谁来保护无辜的人？

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
I see your greed and we will have none of it here! It seems you do not truly care for others!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
看得出你很贪婪，我们这里容不下这种人！
你根本不关心别人！
滚！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Lastly...
what's the most
important value
a Knight must have?
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
最后...
骑士最重要的品质是什么？

scripts.text: Honor
scripts.translation: 荣誉

scripts.text: Wealth
scripts.translation: 财富

scripts.text: Status
scripts.translation: 地位

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Right, above all else, Knights must be honorable! We live and die for honor! Always keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
对，骑士最重要的是守护荣誉！
我们为荣誉而生，为荣誉而死！
一定要铭记。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
You're scum! You strive to become a Knight for personal wealth? Get lost! We will not accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
人渣！
想当骑士，只是为了发财？
滚！
骑士团不会接纳你这种人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
So you're trying to become famous through the Chivalry? That's pathetic. We won't accept someone like you in our Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
想借骑士团扬名？
真可悲。
我们不会接纳你这种人！

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Well then,
this is the
end of my test.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
好，我的考验到此结束。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
For your next
test, please go
see Sir Windsor.
He's very quiet,
but don't let that
get to you.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
下一项考验，去找温莎爵士。
他不怎么说话，别太在意。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职考验

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hey...
You already took my test, didn't you? You're done here. You should go visit Sir Windsor now...
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
嘿...
你不是已经接受过我的考验了吗？
我这里已经结束了，去找温莎爵士吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Hmmm...?
Alright.
It's just that
you had that
look on your
face.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
嗯...？
好吧，只是你刚才那副表情让我有些在意。

scripts.text:
[Sir Siracuse]
Well then,
go and see the
captain. We'll all
be there to evaluate
your performance.
scripts.translation:
[西拉库斯爵士]
好，去找团长吧。
我们会一起评议你的表现。

[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
Protect.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
保护。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Go play
outside.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...去外面玩吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Hmpf.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...哼。

...What?
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...什么？

[Sir Windsor]

scripts.translation: [温莎爵士]

...

...

...

...Fine.
scripts.translation:

...好吧。

scripts.text:

...Follow me.
scripts.translation:

...跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...This way.
scripts.translation:

...

...

...

scripts.translation:

...有问题？

scripts.translation: 考什么？

scripts.text: How do I take the test?
scripts.translation: 怎么参加考验？

scripts.text: I'd like to leave.
scripts.translation: 我想离开

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
......

[Sir Windsor]
...You fight monsters.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...与魔物战斗。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Kill them all.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...把它们全部消灭。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Three stages.
Beat them all.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...三个阶段。
全部通过。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
......3 minutes
for each stage.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...每关3分钟。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
..........

[Sir Windsor]
...Go in the
waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...去候考室。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Then it
will begin.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...然后开始。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...You have to wait
if someone is testing.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...有人在考，就等着。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...You can go in
after that person.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...等那人考完，再进去。

the next level.

[温莎爵士]
...去下一关。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...One stage left.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...还剩一关。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]

[Sir Windsor]
...Very good.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...很好。

scripts.text:
[Sir Windsor]
...Go talk to
Amy Beatrice now.
scripts.translation:
[温莎爵士]
...去找艾米·贝阿特丽丝。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh...!
I wonder, why
have you come
to visit me?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哎呀...！
怎么想到来看我呀？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
What a cute
little Novice!
Soooooo cute!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哇~
好可爱的小初心者！
真是太可爱了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Welcome to
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
欢迎来到普隆德拉骑士团~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ooh, you're
a Swordsman...?
Did you come to
change jobs to
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哦，你是剑士...？
来转职骑士的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Hmmm?
Why did you
come to Amy?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯？
找艾米有什么事呀？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are a Knight and you are looking for a party in Morocc.
How would you go about doing so?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
假设你是一名骑士，正在梦罗克找队伍。
你会怎么做呢？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Wow~
Now it's time for
everyone to decide
on your job change!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哇~
该由大家决定你能不能转职了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You're not having
trouble as a Knight,
are you? Well, I think
you're doing well~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
当骑士没遇到什么困难吧？
我觉得你做得很好呢~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Of course~
You're a member of
the Prontera Chivalry~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
那当然~
你可是普隆德拉骑士团的一员~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Heh heh...
Are you interested
in becoming a Knight
later on? You'd be
a great Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
Heh heh...
以后想当骑士吗？
你一定会是个很棒的骑士~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Remember, you're
going to be a Knight,
alright? Promise?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
说好了，以后要当骑士哦？
答应我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
We're only Knights,
but hope you enjoy
your stay here.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我们虽只是骑士，也希望你在这里待得开心。
Heh heh~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
To apply, talk
to the captain
all the way over
there. Hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
想申请的话，去那边找团长吧。
Hee hee~

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职考验

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~
You applied to change jobs! Okay! You'll soon be a Knight with that kind of determination!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~
你申请转职了！
好呀，有这份决心，很快就能当上骑士！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But...
You have to go
to the other Knights
before talking to Amy.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
不过...
来找艾米之前，要先去找其他骑士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'd love to test
you from the beginning,
but I'm not allowed to.
Hee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我也想从一开始就考验你，可惜不允许呢。
Hee hee~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww~
Alright...
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哎呀~
好吧...

scripts.text: Sir Windsor told me to--
scripts.translation: 温莎爵士让我来--

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Oh!
No need to say
anything more.
Welcome! It's time
to take Amy's test!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哦！
不用再说了。
欢迎！
该接受艾米的考验了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
My name is Amy Beatrice,
a proud Lady Knight of the Prontera Chivalry. Amy's test will test your etiquette as a Knight~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我叫艾米·贝阿特丽丝，是普隆德拉骑士团引以为荣的女骑士。
艾米要考考你身为骑士的礼仪~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'll tell you a story and you choose an answer whenever
I ask a question. Your etiquette will be judged on your answers.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我会讲个故事，每次提问，你都要选一个答案。
我会根据你的回答，判断你是否懂得礼仪。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
So listen carefully
and answer as if you're
already a Knight, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
仔细听，把自己当成真正的骑士来回答，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Then,
let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
那么，开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Aww...
Alright~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
哎呀...
好吧~

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职考验

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm~?
Have you learned
what you did wrong
last time? If you
fail again, I'm going
to be mad!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯~？
明白上次错在哪里了吗？
再不通过，我可要生气了！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
So listen carefully
and answer as if you
are a Knight.
Well then,
let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
仔细听，把自己当成骑士来回答。
好，开始吧！

scripts.translation: 开聊天室等待

scripts.translation: 找正在招募骑士的人

[Lady Amy]
You have formed a party with equal leveled players. There's a Priest, a Wizard, a Hunter, an Assassin, and a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你和等级相近的玩家组成了队伍。
队里有牧师、巫师、猎人、刺客和铁匠...

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The six of you decide to go hunt and have decided to go to the Pyramids.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你们六人决定一起狩猎，目的地是金字塔。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You reach Level 4
of the Pyramids
with your party.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你和队友到了金字塔第4层。
你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Check out the area and plan ahead.
scripts.translation: 观察周围，提前制定计划

scripts.text: Gather monsters for your party members.
scripts.translation: 替队友聚集魔物

scripts.text: Lead the party slowly at the front.
scripts.translation: 走在前方，带队缓慢前进

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But some rude players came with a group of monsters and disappeared! What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
这时，几个没礼貌的玩家引来一群魔物，自己却消失了！
你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Keep the monsters from reaching the party.
scripts.translation: 阻止魔物靠近队伍

scripts.text: Defend while the party retreats.
scripts.translation: 掩护队伍撤退

scripts.text: Run away on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation: 骑着大嘴鸟逃跑

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Luckily, you all lived through the crisis. But as you walk, you find a person, who is not in your party, collapsed on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
幸好，大家平安度过了危机。
继续前进时，你们发现一个不属于队伍的人倒在地上。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
The person is asking politely for help. What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
那个人礼貌地向你们求助。
你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Ask your party's Priest to help.
scripts.translation: 请队里的牧师帮忙

scripts.text: Say you will help for Zeny.
scripts.translation: 表示可以帮忙，但要收Zeny

scripts.text: Ignore and move on.
scripts.translation: 不理会，继续前进

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You must bid farewell to your party members because you must go somewhere else.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你要去别的地方，只好向队友告别。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you find
a rare item during
the battle. What
should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
不过，战斗时你得到了一件稀有物品。
你该怎么处理？

scripts.text: Give it to who deserves it the most.
scripts.translation: 给最应得的人

scripts.text: Pretend like nothing happened and keep it.
scripts.translation: 假装什么都没发生，自己留下

scripts.text: Decide with party who gets it.
scripts.translation: 和队友商量归谁

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You end up with the item and you go to Prontera to sell it. There are many people with shops and chat rooms opened selling items.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
最后，物品归了你。
你去普隆德拉卖掉它，那里有很多人开着商店或聊天室出售物品。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
What should you
do to sell your item?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
想卖掉这件物品，你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Shout out loud to everyone.
scripts.translation: 向所有人大声喊话

scripts.text: Open a chat room and wait.
scripts.translation: 开聊天室等待

scripts.text: Inquire if there is anyone that is interested.
scripts.translation: 询问有没有人感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
While you are waiting,
someone comes and begs
for items and zeny.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
等待时，有人来向你讨要物品和Zeny。
你会怎么做？

scripts.text: Give them some Zeny and items.
scripts.translation: 给对方一些Zeny和物品

scripts.text: Simply ignore them.
scripts.translation: 直接不理会

scripts.text: Give suggestions for a place to hunt.
scripts.translation: 推荐合适的狩猎地点

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now you decide to go to the Hidden Temple by yourself. You happily ride on your Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
接着，你决定独自去隐藏神殿，开心地骑着大嘴鸟出发了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
But you run into
someone that is lost.
What should you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
不过，你遇到一个迷路的人。
你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Tell the person how to reach the exit.
scripts.translation: 告诉对方怎么去出口

scripts.text: Lead the person to the exit.
scripts.translation: 带对方去出口

scripts.text: Give a Butterfly Wing.
scripts.translation: 给对方一个蝴蝶翅膀

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You've been hunting for a while, and now you're low on HP!
It's red now, which is very dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
狩猎了一阵后，你的HP已经很低了！
HP变成红色，非常危险。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Ah, then a Priest
happens to walk by.
How would you ask
the Priest for a Heal?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
这时，恰好有位牧师路过。
你会怎么请对方施展治愈术？

scripts.text: Would it be possible to get a heal please?
scripts.translation: 请问可以麻烦您帮我治疗一下吗？

scripts.text: Can I have a heal?
scripts.translation: 能给我治疗一下吗？

scripts.text: Heal plz!!
scripts.translation: 求治疗！！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You are now very
exhausted and it's time
to go back to town.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
现在你已经很累，该回城了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You then find
a rare item on
the street.
What should
you do?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
这时，你在路上发现一件稀有物品。
你该怎么做？

scripts.text: Pick it up and keep it.
scripts.translation: 捡起来，自己留下

scripts.text: Ask around to find the owner.
scripts.translation: 四处打听，寻找失主

scripts.text: Simply walk by.
scripts.translation: 直接走过去

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Okay,
that was the
end of my test!
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
好了，我的考验结束！

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well done, that kind of mentality is needed for a Knight! For your next test, visit Sir Edmond, please~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
做得好，骑士就该有这样的心态！
下一项考验，去找埃德蒙爵士吧~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Well, it wasn't perfect,
but I think you know enough
about etiquette to be
a fine Knight.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯，虽然不是十全十美，但你已经懂得足够的礼仪，能成为出色的骑士了。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Mmm...
To be honest, I don't think your attitude is good enough to be a Knight quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
嗯...
说实话，你现在的态度，还不太适合当骑士。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
I'll have nice comments about you for the captain. Do well on the tests you have left, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
我会在团长面前好好夸夸你。
剩下的考验也要好好表现哦？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Now, it's time for you to go to Sir Edmond for your next test. Do well on the rest of your tests. You better promise~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
现在去找埃德蒙爵士，接受下一项考验吧。
后面的考验也要好好表现，答应我哦~

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you really act like that, everyone will think Knights are rude! Think about how you answered my questions and come again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
真要那样做，大家都会觉得骑士没礼貌！
好好想想刚才的回答，过会儿再来。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
If you want,
I'll let you
retake the test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
你愿意的话，我可以让你再考一次，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You have to go to
Sir Edmond for your
next test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
下一项考验，要去找埃德蒙爵士，记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
Let's go talk to our
captain. Don't worry
too much. It should
be okay.
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
去找团长谈谈吧。
别太担心，应该没问题的。

scripts.text:
[Lady Amy]
You still have
other tests to take.
Hurry and finish~
scripts.translation:
[艾米女士]
还有其他考验没完成呢。
快去吧~

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Think of your
mind as if it were
flowing water.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
试着让心如流水。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Trees with deep roots don't sway with the wind. The fact that powerful skills must be built on strong basics is immutable...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
根深的树，不会随风摇摆。
强大的技艺必须建立在牢固的基础上，这是不变的道理...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Everything in this world exists in harmony. Living without disrupting this harmony is the right way to live...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
世间万物和谐共存。
顺应这份和谐，而不破坏它，才是正确的生存之道...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Those with ominous thoughts will only dream such dreams. It's better to have no dreams at all than to have dreams of sadness and despair.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
心怀不祥之念，梦中也只有不祥。
与其梦见悲伤和绝望，不如无梦。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman?
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
有什么事吗...
流浪的剑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
What is it...
Wandering Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
有什么事吗...
流浪的剑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
I have seen your character for myself. It is now time for you to take the last test. Go and speak
to Sir Gray...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我已亲眼见识你的品行。
该接受最后一项考验了，去找格雷爵士吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go and speak
to our captain.
The time has come
for all of us to
evaluate your
performance.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
去找团长吧。
该由我们一起评议你的表现了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Flowing water
avoids obstacles,
going on its way...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
流水绕过阻碍，继续前行...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights must be
able to pass things,
like calm water, in
any situation.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
骑士也应如平静的流水，无论身处何境，都能从容应对。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Your future
can even be
decided now...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你的未来，也许此刻就能决定...

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职考验

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
A seed must first be nestled
in the earth before the seed may sprout. Then, the sprout must grow leaves before its buds blossom into flowers...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
种子先埋入土中，才能萌芽。
嫩芽先长出叶子，花蕾才能绽放...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
If not...
The flower will
be incomplete.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
否则...
花朵便不完整。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Go to the others
first, so that you
may find your path...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
先去找其他人，才能寻到自己的道路...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你期盼的生活，很快就会展现在眼前。
一切自有先后。

scripts.text: Lady Amy sent me.
scripts.translation: 艾米女士让我来的

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
It is now time to take my test. Please do your best, as you have done on the other tests.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
现在，该接受我的考验了。
像之前一样，全力以赴吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
My name is
Edmond Groster.
I am a member of
the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
我叫埃德蒙·格罗斯特，是普隆德拉骑士团的一员。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Knights are in the position for others to follow. Therefore, you must modestly think about the world's order and have the personality to fit the role you will play.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
骑士是他人追随的榜样。
因此，你应谦逊地思考世间的秩序，修养与身份相称的品格。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not make careless decisions. Your will should bend as the reeds or be as firm as stone when the situation calls for it.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
不可草率决断。
应变通时，如芦苇般柔韧；应坚持时，如磐石般坚定。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You must not kill monsters without reason and not take joy in doing so. Take this time to quietly think about this on your own...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
不可无故杀戮魔物，更不可引以为乐。
趁这段时间，独自静心思考吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
Then, we shall
begin the test.
Keep in mind
the quality of
reverence.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
那么，开始考验。
切记，心怀敬畏。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life you want
will soon be before
your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你期盼的生活，很快就会展现在眼前。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不是故意的...

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
You were too careless in the last test. A Knight's sword exists to protect others, not to torment weaker monsters.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
上次考验，你太草率了。
骑士的剑，是为了保护他人，不是为了欺凌弱小的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
In a world where everything exists in harmony, you can't have humans continuously destroying without purpose. This principle applies to the real world, not to this test alone.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
世间万物和谐共存，人类不可无休止地肆意破坏。
这个道理，不只适用于考验，也适用于现实。

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The test
shall begin.
Show me your
patience...
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
考验开始。
让我看看你的耐心...

scripts.text:
[Sir Edmond]
The life that you
want will soon be
before your eyes.
Everything will
come in perfect
order.
scripts.translation:
[埃德蒙爵士]
你期盼的生活，很快就会展现在眼前。
一切自有先后。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The glint of light
that shines off this blade cannot be put into words. This is the weapon every Knight must have.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
这剑刃映出的光芒，实在难以言喻。
每位骑士都该拥有这样的武器。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Believe it
or not, I was
once a Novice
as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
信不信由你，我也曾是初心者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
年轻人，要善用时间。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
Yes, what can
I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦...
年轻的剑士。
有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, you again.
What brings you
to me?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，又是你。
有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
想变得更强，是吗？
没错，骑士确实强大。
但你为什么要追求力量？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
啊，为了帮助公会，也可能是队伍。
英明仁慈的特里斯拉姆三世国王，曾赐予我们这样一句金玉良言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
为了满足自己，是吗？
你似乎已经是个出色的剑士了。
有什么特别的理由，让你想当骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
[格雷爵士]
我理解你的想法。
不过，有些人想当骑士，却从未认真想过原因。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I told you
to go to
the captain.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我说过，去找团长。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh...
A young Swordman.
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦...
年轻的剑士。
有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Yes...
^3355FFClaymore^000000!
Every Knight
would want one!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
没错...
^3355FF双手剑^000000！
每位骑士都会想要一把！

scripts.text: About ^3355FFClaymore^000000
Buy Claymore
scripts.translation: 购买双手剑

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Claymore, one of the best among the famous swords you can attain in Rune-Midgarts' Prontera!! Its value is priceless when considered by a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
双手剑，是卢恩·米德加兹王国普隆德拉能买到的名剑中最出色的几把之一！
对骑士而言，它可是无价之宝。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Now, the Prontera Chivalry is making these fabulous Claymores. For Knights, they are only ^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
如今，普隆德拉骑士团正在打造这些精美的双手剑。
骑士购买，只要^3355FF74,000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But not only that, you need
1 ^3355FFSteel^000000 because of the Claymore's characteristics. If you like, I can create one for you. For the honor of the Prontera Chivalry!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
不过，由于双手剑的特性，还需要1个^3355FF钢铁^000000。
愿意的话，我可以替你打造一把。
为了普隆德拉骑士团的荣誉！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
It seems that you are carrying too many things. You don't have enough space for a heavy Claymore in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哎呀...
你带的东西太多，背包装不下沉重的双手剑了。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Why don't you
go and organize
your items first.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先去整理一下物品吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You are ready!
You must know the
true value of
a Claymore!
I shall make
it right now!!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
都准备好了！
看来你很懂双手剑的真正价值！
我现在就打造！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The basics of
making the Claymore
is easy. Watch~!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
打造双手剑的基本步骤很简单。
看好了~！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Stir Stir*^000000
^3355FF*Ooncha Ooncha*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*Stir Stir*^000000
^3355FF*Ooncha Ooncha*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Okay, it's ready!
Every Knight's pride:
a fine ^3355FFClaymore^000000.
You attained a reliable item.
It'll be a good companion on your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
好，完成了！
精美的^3355FF双手剑^000000，每位骑士的骄傲。
这把武器值得信赖，会成为你冒险时的好伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I realize you may really want a Claymore, but I can't make it without the materials.
^3355FF74,000 zeny^000000 and ^3355FF1 Steel!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我知道你很想要双手剑，可没有材料，我也造不出来。
需要^3355FF74,000 Zeny^000000和^3355FF1个钢铁！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Come back when
you have everything
ready. I shall be
waiting...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
准备齐全再来吧。
我会在这里等你...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Any Knight should be able to wield a Claymore as if it were an extension of their body. I used to look forward to brandishing my Claymore in battle...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
骑士应该把双手剑使得如同自己的手脚一般。
我以前也总盼着在战场上挥舞双手剑...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I never really planned to become a Knight, but I did decide to become a strong person. Somehow, along my journeys, I ended up joining the Prontera Chivalry. Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我原本没打算当骑士，只是想成为强者。
不知不觉，旅途中就加入了普隆德拉骑士团。
Ha ha ha!

scripts.text:
Young one,
use your time
wisely.
scripts.translation: 年轻人，要善用时间。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
时光一去不返，后悔也无济于事。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
No point in
harboring regret
once time has passed.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
时光一去不返，后悔也无济于事。

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职考验

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho, I see.
So you took
everyone else's
test?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
Hoho,
我明白了。
其他人的考验都参加过了？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then shall
we begin mine?
It's not really
a test though.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么，开始我的考验吧？
不过，其实也算不上考验。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Let's talk
casually,
shall we?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我们随意聊聊，如何？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先说说...
你为什么决定当骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！

scripts.text: I've been thinking a lot.
scripts.translation: 我认真想过了

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is that so...
I wonder if you
truly have...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
是吗...
不知道你是否真的想过...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then...
Like last time,
I will ask again...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么，和上次一样，我再问一遍...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
First...
Why did you
decide to become
a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先说说...
你为什么决定当骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！
健康是每个人最宝贵的财富！

scripts.text: To become stronger...
scripts.translation: 为了变得更强...

scripts.text: To help my guild...
scripts.translation: 为了帮助我的公会...

scripts.text: Because I'm unsatisfied with myself right now...
scripts.translation: 因为我不满现在的自己...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
To become stronger, you say?
Yes, Knights are indeed strong.
But why gain strength?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
想变得更强，是吗？
没错，骑士确实强大。
但你为什么要追求力量？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Is it to show off to others? To attain fame? Or do you have a diferent reason? What do you think is so good about gaining strength as a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
为了向别人炫耀？
为了扬名？
还是另有原因？
你认为获得骑士的力量，有什么好处？

scripts.text: Gain wealth and fame.
scripts.translation: 获得财富和名声

scripts.text: I can protect myself.
scripts.translation: 能保护自己

scripts.text: I can protect others.
scripts.translation: 能保护他人

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course, wealth and fame have their place in the world. But we as Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
当然，财富与名声自有其价值。
但身为骑士，我们应为更高尚的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good thinking. You must first be able to protect yourself in order to protect others. To this end, you must constantly train, and never give in to laziness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
想得好。
先能保护自己，才能保护别人。
因此，必须勤加训练，绝不懈怠。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，想得很好。
骑士的力量，应该用来保护弱小、捍卫正义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
令人遗憾的是，有些骑士忘记了骑士道的基本准则，令我们蒙羞...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, to help your guild, or maybe even your party. Our wise and benevolent King Tristram the 3rd gave us these golden words...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，为了帮助公会，也可能是队伍。
英明仁慈的特里斯拉姆三世国王，曾赐予我们这样一句金玉良言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
^8B7500Beyond the calm river, lies a dangerous waterfall. Therefore, you must always be prepared for everything...^000000
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
^8B7500平静河流的前方，也可能有危险的瀑布。
因此，凡事都应时刻做好准备...^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So how do you
think you can
help your guild?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么，你认为自己能怎样帮助公会？

scripts.text: My guild needs me.
scripts.translation: 公会需要我

scripts.text: I can help gather funds for my guild.
scripts.translation: 我能为公会筹集资金

scripts.text: I can protect my guild members.
scripts.translation: 我能保护公会成员

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Anyone, anywhere in this world,
has a place where they are needed. Never neglect someone in need, even if he is not a guild member.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
世上的每个人，都有需要自己的地方。
不要忽视求助的人，即使对方不是公会成员。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Of course wealth is important.
But we Knights must live for higher virtues.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
财富当然重要。
但身为骑士，我们应为更高尚的美德而活。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Ah, a wonderful idea. A Knight's strength must be used to protect the weak and defend righteousness.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
啊，想得很好。
骑士的力量，应该用来保护弱小、捍卫正义。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Sadly, there are a few Knights who shame us by forgetting the ideals that should be basic to Knighthood...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
令人遗憾的是，有些骑士忘记了骑士道的基本准则，令我们蒙羞...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Satisfaction, you say.
It seems like you are
already a fine Swordman.
Is there a particular reason you wish to be a Knight?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
为了满足自己，是吗？
你似乎已经是个出色的剑士了。
有什么特别的理由，让你想当骑士？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I don't know about
Swordmen, but Knights do not allow self-indulgence. There are those so obsessed with gaining strength that they cannot control themselves.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
剑士如何，我不清楚，但骑士绝不能放纵自己。
有人执迷于追求力量，甚至失去了自制。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
So...
What part of yourself
are you not satisfied
with right now?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么...
现在，你对自己的哪方面不满意？

scripts.text: Skills.
scripts.translation: 技能

scripts.text: Goal.
scripts.translation: 目标

scripts.text: Appearance.
scripts.translation: 外表

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Skill is something you gain with experience as a Knight. It cannot be your highest goal. Otherwise, you'll never be satisfied as a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
当了骑士，技艺自然会随着经验增长。
它不该是你最高的目标。
否则，即使成了骑士，你也永远不会满足。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see...
Always having a goal is very important. You may be full of ideas upon becoming a Knight, but that may change with time.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我明白了...
始终有个目标，非常重要。
刚当上骑士时，你也许有许多想法，不过，它们也会随着时间改变。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no...
What you see isn't what really counts. A Swordman may be stronger than a Knight, and even Knight may grow weak if he becomes lazy.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦，不...
眼睛看到的，并非真正重要的东西。
剑士也可能比骑士强，骑士一旦懈怠，也会变得弱小。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I understand your thoughts,
but there are those who wish to
become Knights without thinking.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我理解你的想法。
不过，有些人想当骑士，却从未认真想过原因。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those are the ones who instigate problems and shame the honor of Knights, bringing irreversible results.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
正是这种人惹是生非，玷污骑士的荣誉，酿成无法挽回的后果。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
The same goes for you as well. Once you become a Knight, you can never become a Swordman again. The duties and responsibilities of a Knight will always be with you.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
你也一样。
一旦成了骑士，就不能再变回剑士。
骑士的职责与责任，将始终伴随你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you become a Knight right away, what are you going to do first?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
如果现在就成为骑士，你会先做什么？

scripts.text: I am going to go straight to battle.
scripts.translation: 立刻投入战斗

scripts.text: There are those waiting for me.
scripts.translation: 有人在等我

scripts.text: I will learn more about Knights.
scripts.translation: 进一步了解骑士

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Battle...?
And then?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
战斗...？
然后呢？

scripts.text: I will grow within a short period of time.
scripts.translation: 尽快成长

scripts.text: I would like to test my ability as a Knight.
scripts.translation: 检验自己身为骑士的能力

scripts.text: I would like to go to more challenging places.
scripts.translation: 去更有挑战性的地方

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't be in too much of a hurry to become strong. Even if you become
a Knight, you are still yourself.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
别急于变强。
即使当了骑士，你也还是原来的你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Testing yourself is a good thing. It's okay to be happy about how you change, but don't forget about the true qualities of being a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
检验自己是件好事。
为自身的变化高兴，也无妨，但别忘了骑士应有的品格。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Even if you become a Knight, you are not changing your inner self. No need to overwork yourself.
Relax and take things step by step.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
成为骑士，并不会让你内在的自己改变。
不必过分勉强，放松些，一步一步来。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Who is
waiting for you?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
谁在等你？

scripts.text: My friends.
scripts.translation: 我的朋友

scripts.text: My Guild members.
scripts.translation: 我的公会同伴

scripts.text: My Lover.
scripts.translation: 我的恋人

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I see, they would share in the joy of your achievements. Don't ever lose your kind heart, and always give help to your friends.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
我明白了，他们会为你的成就一同欢喜。
要始终心怀善意，帮助朋友。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Those who would share in your happiness and hardship. As a Knight, you must always protect them.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
与你同甘共苦的人。
身为骑士，你应始终保护他们。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh, youth!
Becoming a Knight
for your beloved!
Always protect {0}...
Even at the sacrifice
of your own life!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦，青春啊！
为了挚爱成为骑士！
要始终保护{0}...
哪怕牺牲自己的生命！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Also...
Love them forever.
Sincere affection
is hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
还有...
永远爱着对方。
真挚的感情，难能可贵。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Good attitude...
What do you plan
on learning?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
态度不错...
你打算了解什么？

scripts.text: Comfortable places for Knights to go...
scripts.translation: 适合骑士去的舒适地方...

scripts.text: The different paths of a Knight...
scripts.translation: 骑士的不同道路...

scripts.text: Ways to get more money as a Knight...
scripts.translation: 骑士赚更多钱的方法...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many places that are comfortable or uncomfortable in this world. However Knights must
be able to survive anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
世上有舒适的地方，也有艰苦的地方。
但骑士必须能在任何地方生存。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
There are many similar Knights outside in the world. Think of them as your seniors and ask many questions.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
外面还有许多和你一样的骑士。
把他们当作前辈，多多请教。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no. Do you hold wealth as a priority of being a Knight? We're not meant to be that way. Come again when you have thought
more about it...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哦，不。
你把发财当成骑士的首要目标？
我们不该如此。
好好想想，再回来吧...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Oh no, we've been
talking too much...
I apologize for
keeping you here
for so long.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
哎呀，我们聊得太久了...
抱歉，让你在这里耽搁了这么久。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. You remind me of myself as a young recruit. Shall we talk to the captain and decide on your
job change?
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你聊得很愉快。
你让我想起年轻时刚入团的自己。
去找团长，决定你能否转职吧？

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too
much, I have a very
high opinion of you.
Now, go~
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
别太担心，我对你的评价很高。
去吧~

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed speaking with you. You can think about the principles of Knighthood more once you become a Knight.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你交谈很愉快。
成为骑士后，还可以继续思考骑士之道。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Then, shall we go to the captain and decide on your job change? Don't worry too much. You are good enough to be a Knight!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
那么，去找团长，决定你能否转职吧？
别太担心，你已经具备骑士的资格！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
I enjoyed talking with you. Although, there were some
things that bothered me...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和你聊得很愉快。
不过，有些地方还是让我有些在意...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
You should go
to the captain
so we can decide
on your job change.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
去找团长吧，我们好决定你能否转职。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Don't worry too much, coming to take my test means the others have acknowledged you as well.
Go now...!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
别太担心，能来接受我的考验，说明其他人也认可了你。
去吧...！

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Conversing
with young ones
is always enjoyable...
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
和年轻人交谈，总是令人愉快...

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
But it seems as though your dream is elsewhere, or that your focus is hazy. Spend more time as a Swordman, and come back
to me later.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
不过，你似乎另有所求，或是目标还不明确。
再以剑士的身份磨炼一段时间，之后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you truly wish to become a Knight, you must change your outlook first. Then, we shall see.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
真想当骑士，就得先改变想法。
之后，再看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Everyone will
carefully make
their decision,
so go now!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
各位都会慎重决定，去吧！

scripts.text: I would like to take the test to change jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想参加转职考验

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，没什么

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Hoho~
There are many
other younger
Knights in here.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
Hoho~
这里还有许多年轻的骑士。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
If you talk
to all of them,
I may review
you as well.
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
先去和他们一一谈谈，也许我会重新评价你。

scripts.text:
[Sir Gray]
Take care!
Health is
every man's
treasure!
scripts.translation:
[格雷爵士]
保重！
健康是每个人最宝贵的财富！
